Want to experience the nano-texture feel on your iPad screen without making a long-term commitment? Astropad has launched a brand new version of Rock Paper Pencil, retaining the detachable design while adding a second writing feel.

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 brings a graphite pencil-like feel to Apple Pencil and iPad

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 pairs a nano-texture screen protector with a custom Apple Pencil tip. For the first time, buyers can choose between a smooth ballpoint pen-like feel and a softer, more friction-draggy graphite pencil-like feel.

The all-new graphite tip design mimics a 2B pencil, including the extra friction that artists may prefer when sketching, shading, and making expressive strokes.

Astropad says the company spent about a year developing this new option, using a standard 2B pencil as a reference. Astropad says the final product can also reproduce the look and sound of real graphite.

Choose between ballpoint or standard pencil feel

At the same time, the existing steel ballpoint tips remain available, suitable for writing, drawing, precise line cleanup, and neat note-taking. Each Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 set now contains a total of four Apple Pencil tips: two ballpoint tips and two graphite tips.

The screen protector itself is unchanged. Astropad's exclusive NanoCling system uses electrostatic adhesion instead of adhesives, allowing the protector to be applied, removed, and reused without leaving residue.

The company says its adhesion is stronger than a magnet while still supporting bubble-free application and easy removal. The protector's micro-texture mimics the roughness of fine-grain paper, providing friction and better control.

The best matte screen protector for iPad

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 doesn't just change one side—the Apple Pencil tip or the screen texture—but treats them as one integrated system. Astropad says its custom tips are designed specifically to work with the nano-texture protector. The new graphite tips are made of POM (polyoxymethylene), while the ballpoint version uses steel.

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 is now on sale for $49.99 with worldwide shipping. While stocks last, you can also purchase the 3.0 version at a special price.
